column1: # Hand-curated phone spec catalogue, 2026-10-04. One row per phone (generation).
# Empty cells mean unknown, never zero: a cell is left empty rather than guessed.
# model: the name as ElectronicsExtractor writes it (brand prefix and a trailing release year are ignored by the lookup, see PhoneSpecCatalog.ModelKey).

# aliases: other spellings of the model, separated by ';'. A model written without a year that several rows share (Galaxy A5 2015/2016/2017) is ambiguous: the lookup then returns only what all rows agree on.
# os: the platform family (Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, Windows Phone, Symbian, KaiOS, Series 30, Series 30+, Series 40, Proprietary for feature phones without a named platform).
# os_version_launch / os_version_max: major version at launch and the highest OFFICIAL version the device received or is confirmed to receive. For devices that still get updates it is the
#   highest version known at curation (a lower bound) and the row is marked medium.
# screen_inches: diagonal rounded to one decimal. confidence: high (certain) | medium (believed, not certain).
